description: A Core primitive `right` called as `RIGHT` with too few arguments raises ol-not-enough-inputs whose params.callable is the primitive's canonical identity `right`, not the call site casing — a primitive has no declared spelling, so its identity is the profile's canonical name (lowercased, or the Core canonical for a Heritage alias), exactly what the checker reports; case-insensitive identifiers can never make the call spelling the diagnostic identity, so check() and execute() agree (spec/error-model.md:255-260). Issue #1005.
